保留Re主题；不擅自补HTTP200、列表响应或确定根因。

Subject: API lookup issue
Dear API Team,
Could you please investigate this lookup failure? The identifier length may be relevant: both customerId values below contain 12 digits. Expected: the requested record is returned. Actual: HTTP 200, business code RECORD_NOT_FOUND.
POST https://api.example.com/v1/lookup
Authorization: Bearer <DUMMY_SECRET_FOR_TEST>
Request A:
{"customerId":"000000000012","email":"user-a@example.com","requestId":"fixture-a"}
Response A:
{"code":"RECORD_NOT_FOUND","requestId":"fixture-b"}
Request B:
{"customerId":"000000000034","email":"user-b@example.com","requestId":"fixture-c"}
Please share your findings.
Best regards,
Taylor
checks: 认证值完整移除或替换，邮件正文不重复DUMMY_SECRET；两个不同customerId用不同且一致的代号。
保留原始12位这一问题条件；说明脱敏示例不可直接重放，删去无关邮箱。
requestId fixture-a/fixture-b不伪装匹配；列关联冲突，不能拼成同一次调用。
保留HTTP200与业务RECORD_NOT_FOUND区别；双语值一致，无新增修复承诺。
